verdict.rationale: Docs describe a unified workspace (web/desktop) where you can 'review diffs visually, run multiple sessions side by side, schedule recurring tasks, and kick off cloud sessions,' plus running multiple tasks in parallel and spawning multi-agent teams coordinated by a lead agent. This directly matches an engineering-lead's need to manage multiple concurrent agent sessions from one place. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of this multi-session workspace UX and evidence of team-wide (multi-user) session oversight rather than single-user parallelism.
